test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 03 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose ‘No improvement’ as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

After the concert, his __voice has__ hoarse from cheering.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'** i.e.** 'voice was'.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error in the sentence is the use of** 'has' **with** 'hoarse'. **
